title: Different care leaves room for hope
meaning: Combining different ways of participating for development is emotionally expressed through hope for a possible continuation of shared activity.
text: Something shared can grow through different forms of care. Temperance in the physical position of this Energy Field appears through actions where you combine different ways of participating and different needs. The Empress in energy motivates nurturing development and creating tangible fruits of attention. The Star in emotions adds hope, openness and inspiration. The overall tone can be creative: you practically combine differences for the activity’s life, while emotionally seeing a further possibility that need not become a promise of a large or necessarily successful result.

For example, you arrange a small courtyard together. One person builds a comfortable bench, while the other chooses undemanding plants; different actions join around a living space. Once the first welcoming corner appears, you want to imagine future evenings. **Our different ways of caring have made a shared possibility visible.** Enthusiasm concerns an emerging prospect and can coexist with questions about time, weather and the involvement each person can offer later. The beginning can be encouraging without settling those conditions.

A difficulty arises if inspiration is considered sufficient reason to keep expanding the activity. One person is satisfied with the corner, while the other imagines a whole garden and expects equal excitement. Combination becomes a demand for identical scale. The Star promises no fulfilment of every prospect, and the Empress as motivation requires no endless growth. Temperance in action allows the relationship between contributions to change while keeping room for both people’s different wishes and limitations.
